questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which one the following statement regarding helium is incorrect?

options.content: It is used to fill gas balloons instead of hydrogen because it is lighter and non–inflammable
It is used in gas – cooled nuclear reactors
It is used to produce and sustain powerful superconducting reagents
It is used as cryogenic agent for carrying out experiments at low temperatures

questions.explanation: Helium is heavier than hydrogen although it is non-inflammable
